fields.s1_combo: (answer('s1_int.choice') if s1_cond == 'int' else (answer('s1_seg.choice') if s1_cond == 'seg' else ((answer('s1_gain.choice') + answer('s1_loss.choice')) if answer('s1_gain.choice') is not None and answer('s1_loss.choice') is not None else None)))
fields.s1_bc: (1 if (answer('s1_int.choice') if s1_cond == 'int' else (answer('s1_seg.choice') if s1_cond == 'seg' else ((answer('s1_gain.choice') + answer('s1_loss.choice')) if answer('s1_gain.choice') is not None and answer('s1_loss.choice') is not None else None))) == 'BC' else (0 if (answer('s1_int.choice') if s1_cond == 'int' else (answer('s1_seg.choice') if s1_cond == 'seg' else ((answer('s1_gain.choice') + answer('s1_loss.choice')) if answer('s1_gain.choice') is not None and answer('s1_loss.choice') is not None else None))) == 'AD' else None))
fields.s2_sep: (answer('s2_sepJ.J') if s2_cond == 'sepJ' else (answer('s2_sepS.S') if s2_cond == 'sepS' else None))
fields.s3_seq: (None if (answer('s3j_garden.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_garden.first')) is None or (answer('s3j_reading.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_reading.first')) is None else ('improving' if (answer('s3j_garden.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_garden.first')) == 'weed' and (answer('s3j_reading.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_reading.first')) == 'manual' else ('worsening' if (answer('s3j_garden.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_garden.first')) == 'plant' and (answer('s3j_reading.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_reading.first')) == 'novel' else 'spreading')))
fields.s3_spread: (None if (None if (answer('s3j_garden.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_garden.first')) is None or (answer('s3j_reading.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_reading.first')) is None else ('improving' if (answer('s3j_garden.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_garden.first')) == 'weed' and (answer('s3j_reading.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_reading.first')) == 'manual' else ('worsening' if (answer('s3j_garden.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_garden.first')) == 'plant' and (answer('s3j_reading.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_reading.first')) == 'novel' else 'spreading'))) is None else (1 if (None if (answer('s3j_garden.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_garden.first')) is None or (answer('s3j_reading.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_reading.first')) is None else ('improving' if (answer('s3j_garden.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_garden.first')) == 'weed' and (answer('s3j_reading.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_reading.first')) == 'manual' else ('worsening' if (answer('s3j_garden.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_garden.first')) == 'plant' and (answer('s3j_reading.first') if s3_cond == 'joint' else answer('s3s_reading.first')) == 'novel' else 'spreading'))) == 'spreading' else 0))
fields.s4_sure: (None if (answer('s4_small.choice') if s4_cond == 'small' else answer('s4_large.choice')) is None else (1 if (answer('s4_small.choice') if s4_cond == 'small' else answer('s4_large.choice')) == 'sure' else 0))
fields.s5_take1: (None if (answer('s5_joint.day1') if s5_cond == 'joint' else answer('s5_sep.day1')) is None else (1 if (answer('s5_joint.day1') if s5_cond == 'joint' else answer('s5_sep.day1')) == 'take' else 0))
fields.s5_joint_taken: ((sum([1 for x in ['s5_joint.day1', 's5_joint.day2', 's5_joint.day3', 's5_joint.day4', 's5_joint.day5'] if answer(x) == 'take']) if all([answer(x) is not None for x in ['s5_joint.day1', 's5_joint.day2', 's5_joint.day3', 's5_joint.day4', 's5_joint.day5']]) else None) if s5_cond == 'joint' else None)
fields.s6_attend: (None if {'week': answer('s6_week.choice'), 'month': answer('s6_month.choice'), 'year': answer('s6_year.choice')}[s6_cond] is None else (1 if {'week': answer('s6_week.choice'), 'month': answer('s6_month.choice'), 'year': answer('s6_year.choice')}[s6_cond] == 'yes' else 0))
fields.s7_days: ((sum([answer(x) for x in ['s7_week.mon', 's7_week.tue', 's7_week.wed', 's7_week.thu', 's7_week.fri', 's7_week.sat', 's7_week.sun']]) if all([answer(x) is not None for x in ['s7_week.mon', 's7_week.tue', 's7_week.wed', 's7_week.thu', 's7_week.fri', 's7_week.sat', 's7_week.sun']]) else None) if s7_cond == 'week' else ((sum([answer(x) for x in ['s7_wd.mon', 's7_wd.tue', 's7_wd.wed', 's7_wd.thu', 's7_wd.fri', 's7_we.sat', 's7_we.sun']]) if all([answer(x) is not None for x in ['s7_wd.mon', 's7_wd.tue', 's7_wd.wed', 's7_wd.thu', 's7_wd.fri', 's7_we.sat', 's7_we.sun']]) else None) if s7_cond == 'wdwe' else (sum([answer(x) for x in ['s7_d1.eat', 's7_d2.eat', 's7_d3.eat', 's7_d4.eat', 's7_d5.eat', 's7_d6.eat', 's7_d7.eat']]) if all([answer(x) is not None for x in ['s7_d1.eat', 's7_d2.eat', 's7_d3.eat', 's7_d4.eat', 's7_d5.eat', 's7_d6.eat', 's7_d7.eat']]) else None)))
